component.name: PairDrop
component.summary: Send files and text to nearby devices

description.p: A native client for PairDrop, the self-hosted file transfer service. Devices on the same network find each other automatically; drop files on one and they are there. Transfers go peer-to-peer over a WebRTC data channel and never touch the server.
Devices on different networks can be paired with a six-digit key, after which they stay visible from anywhere.
PairDrop needs a server to connect through — your own instance, or a public one. Nothing is configured by default.
